summary: Iteration 42 - Complete frontend testing of Room Finish Schedule feature. All 10 test cases PASSED. Material palette displays 4 tiles with images, tile selection shows 'SELECTED: [tile name]' message with green ring highlight, clicking wall zones places tiles, pattern picker shows all 8 patterns, canvas elements render with non-zero dimensions, pattern labels display in amber/orange text (text-amber-300), NO green rings on wall zones (bug fix verified), empty zones show 'CLICK TO PLACE' when tile selected, DESELECT button works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Pattern labels use text-amber-300 class (rgb(252, 211, 77)) - correct amber/orange color
WallZone component correctly shows 'CLICK TO PLACE' text with dashed amber border when isSelected=true and no material assigned
Green ring (ring-green-400) only appears on selected palette items, NOT on wall zones (bug fix verified)
DESELECT button properly clears selection and removes 'SELECTED:' message
Pattern picker displays all 8 patterns: STACKED HORIZONTAL, STACKED VERTICAL, OFFSET (BRICK), 1/3 OFFSET, HERRINGBONE, BASKET WEAVE, STEPLADDER, DIAGONAL
TilePatternCanvas uses ResizeObserver for proper canvas sizing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 42 verified all Room Finish Schedule features. The Back Wall shows: CEILING=Black & White Basket Weave (placed during test), UPPER/ACCENT=Subway Tile White Gloss with HERRINGBONE pattern, MAIN WALL=Subway Tile White Gloss with STACKED VERTICAL pattern, CHAIR RAIL=empty, WAINSCOT/CURB=Calacatta Gold Marble with OFFSET (BRICK) pattern, FLOOR=Calacatta Gold Marble with BASKET WEAVE pattern. Pattern labels are in amber-300 color. Canvas rendering works correctly with ResizeObserver.
